map.不一定。波动大往往反映渠道质量分层：少数高价值渠道贡献了大部分回报，多数渠道贡献: Not necessarily. A large fluctuation often reflects tiered channel quality: a few high-value channels contribute most of the return while most contribute little. Use a Pareto view, that is, after this tool gives you the mean and standard deviation, sort by channel to identify the structure where the top 20% delivers 80% of the return, instead of simply drawing a conclusion from the mean.
map.不能。本工具只做回报数据的描述性汇总，ROI =（总回报 − 赞助成本）÷ 赞助: No. This tool only provides a descriptive summary of the return data. ROI = (total return − sponsorship cost) ÷ sponsorship cost, so you must enter the cost yourself. The return definition must also be unified (sales revenue, gross profit, or media equivalent value), otherwise the results are not comparable across sponsors.
